title: tares factory setup --json: the cell's factory setup (also --progress and --repos)
description: One document, with `schema_version` and exactly one of `setup`, `progress` or `repos`. The cell owns the shape of what is inside (tares/screens/factory_setup.py): the crew passes it on as it came, and a caller ignores the keys it does not know. Only the keys the cell always sends are required below; the rest are named so a client can type them, and none of them is closed.

setup.description: `setup --json`: GET /api/factory/setup as the cell answered it. Besides the keys named here it holds `exit_label`, `edition`, `licence`, `onboarding`, `terminal` and `tools`.

progress.description: `setup --progress --json`: GET /api/factory/setup/progress. `projects` is how many factory projects the cell has.

repos.description: `setup --repos --json`: the `repos` list of GET /api/factory/setup/github/repos, owner/name sorted. Empty when GitHub listed none, or is still listing: ask again. A listing GitHub refused is an error (`tares_error`), never an empty list.

text.description: For a person: `N of M done`.

slot.description: The id the cell's routes use for the step (tickets, review, ci, ...).

state.description: `set` or `not_set` today; a caller treats another value as not set.

integration.description: A connected integration or one that could be connected; the two lists share the keys named here.

form.description: The settings form, null when there is nothing to fill in or the integration is not licensed.

app.description: An `available` integration only: the Tares Cloud app block (url, service, button, steps, ...), null where the cell has no app for it.

kind.description: text, secret, url, bool, select or mapping today; a caller shows another kind as text.

value.description: Absent for a secret: a secret never travels, only `saved` says one is kept. A string, a boolean for a bool field, null for a mapping field (its values are in `rows`).

saved.description: A secret field: whether the cell holds a value.

options.description: The choices of a select field; empty for every other kind, a mapping field included (its keys are `rows[].key`).

rows.description: A mapping field: one row per key, with its `key`, `label` and `value`.
